skills.name: code-review-standards
skills.description: Reviews a diff against the core standards and reports findings by severity with file:line and a concrete failure. Use when asked to "review my changes", "review this PR", "is this ready to merge", or to self-check.

skills.name: commit-and-pr
skills.description: Writes Conventional Commits messages, splits work into small commits and PRs, and structures the PR description. Use when asked to "commit this", "write a commit message", "open a PR", "write the PR description".

skills.name: quality-gate
skills.description: Runs npm run quality on changed files and fixes failures: ratchet debt, oversized files, import boundaries. Use before reporting done or opening a PR, "run the checks", "is this green", CI or pre-push failed.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Read-only reviewer that examines the current branch diff against the project's quality, security, error-handling, boundary, performance, testing and naming standards and returns findings by severity. Use when asked for an independent code review, before opening a PR, or to self-check finished work in a separate context.
